issues.description: The sanitize() call on the user-controlled `name` was removed (justified by a misleading 'validated on the client' comment). A name like `../../etc/passwd` escapes UPLOAD_DIR via path.join — directory traversal / arbitrary file read.

readUserFile is typed to always return Buffer, but readFileSync throws on a bad/nonexistent path (ENOENT), so the signature is a contract lie. Pre-existing property, not introduced by the diff — optional. Should declare it throws or return Buffer | null.
